text: Professor, I’m sorry for bothering you. I want to ask if you provide recordings of your lectures online. You’re in my chemistry class, right? Yes, I am. And you’ve been attending the class in person, up until now? Yes, but I haven’t been able to attend class in person for the past week. I’ve been keeping up with the assignments, though. That’s good that you’ve been keeping up with the assignments. The lecture recordings are available to students who are registered for the class. You can access them online on our class page. Oh, okay. Can you tell me where to find them? Sure. They’re in the folder called “Lectures” and I have them organized by class date. Thank you so much, Professor!
